newsitem.title: USA: AEP says expects Q3 net income to fall.
newsitem.headline: AEP says expects Q3 net income to fall.

text.p: AEP Industries warned Monday that, based on preliminary information, it expects earnings for its fiscal third quarter, ending July 31, to be below the earnings reached during the same period last year.

The company said earnings in the third quarter are expected to be roughly the same as in the second quarter of this year, which were $1.99 million, or $0.27 per share. Earnings for the second quarter of 1996 were reported by the company as $2.3 million, or $0.47 per share.

The company, which makes and market plastic packaging products, said in a statement that problems experienced in its U.S. pallet wrap business have not improved and it is reviewing alternatives, including "further cost reductions and allocating production capacity to other products."
